review.crowdstrike.crowdstrike.falcon.is: CrowdStrike Falcon is the industry-leading cloud-native endpoint protection platform. Built from the ground up for the cloud, Falcon delivers world-class threat prevention, detection, and response through a single lightweight agent.
review.crowdstrike.in.2023.crowdstrike.i: In 2023, CrowdStrike introduced Charlotte AI, a generative AI security analyst that helps security teams investigate threats, write queries, and automate responses using natural language. This dramatically accelerates SOC operations and lowers the barrier to advanced threat hunting.
The platform's Threat Graph processes over 2 trillion events daily, providing unmatched threat intelligence and behavioral analytics that stop breaches before they start.
review.crowdstrike.generative.ai.assista: Generative AI assistant for threat hunting, query generation, and incident investigation.
review.crowdstrike.next-gen.antivirus.wi: Next-gen antivirus with ML-based prevention that stops malware and ransomware.
review.crowdstrike.extended.detection.an: Extended detection and response across endpoints, cloud, and identity.
review.crowdstrike.industry-leading.thre: Industry-leading threat intel from CrowdStrike's adversary tracking team.
review.crowdstrike.cnapp.capabilities.fo: CNAPP capabilities for protecting cloud workloads across AWS, Azure, GCP.
review.crowdstrike.falcon.overwatch.prov: Falcon OverWatch provides 24/7 elite threat hunting by CrowdStrike experts.
review.crowdstrike.crowdstrike.uses.modu: CrowdStrike uses module-based licensing. Pricing starts around $8.99/endpoint/month and varies based on modules selected:

review.crowdstrike.managed.detection.and: Managed detection and response. Custom pricing
review.crowdstrike.identity.protection.c: Identity protection, cloud security, log management available
review.crowdstrike.crowdstrike.universit: CrowdStrike University offers specialized certifications focused on the Falcon platform. These credentials validate skills in endpoint detection and response (EDR), threat hunting, and incident response using AI-powered cybersecurity.
Configure and manage CrowdStrike Falcon platform, including prevention policies, detection configuration, and response actions.
